install_fish_completion: install Hydra fish shell completion by printing the fish function and registration commands
uninstall_fish_completion: uninstall Hydra fish shell completion by removing the complete entry and function definition
query_fish_completion: query Hydra fish completion candidates from the COMP_LINE environment variable and print results
help_fish_completion: get the help string for installing or uninstalling Hydra fish shell completion
provides_fish_completion: check if the FishCompletion plugin provides fish shell completion support
